products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital painting and illustration application distributed to the public. The foundation operates under community governance and makes its software freely available, with no dependency on cloud services.

The foundation's AI-related offering is tracked as Krita AI, which falls within the image and graphic design category. The product incorporates local AI plugins into the open-source Krita application, meaning AI features run on the user's own hardware rather than through external cloud infrastructure.

The held facts record no litigation, no MCP servers, and no SEC or patent filings associated with the Krita Foundation. The organization has a verified presence in the site's registry as of August 2026.
